Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog visibly placed inside the bowl of the toilet identified in the source image?
node.criteria: Pass if at least one recognizable frog is visibly situated within the toilet bowl interior, assessed using the bowl opening and rim. A frog solely on the seat, raised lid, tank or floor does not satisfy this condition. Fail if the bowl is sufficiently visible to establish that no frog is inside it. Unknown if visibility or spatial ambiguity prevents determining whether a frog is inside the bowl. Additional frogs elsewhere do not negate satisfaction; exactly one frog is not required.
node.binding: Use the source image to identify the referenced toilet, then inspect that toilet's bowl interior in the edited image for the requested frog placement. Distinguish placement inside the bowl from placement on other toilet surfaces or the surrounding floor. The source is an identity reference, not a requirement that the toilet or scene remain unchanged.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image shows a recognizable frog within the toilet bowl opening, below the rim. Other frogs are on the raised lid and floor, but the frog inside the bowl satisfies the condition.
